root_cause: Rerender-driven async loaders could refetch or replace settled UI with loading placeholders. Smart Swap had both an unkeyed substitutions loader and an exercise intelligence loader that rendered on completion, causing the two loaders to retrigger each other.
repairs: Smart Swap substitutions cached by exercise and swap reason
Previous Performance and progression requests can safely supersede stale in-flight exercise requests
Plan adaptation and recovery loaders use in-flight guards
Progress and Coach sibling loaders use in-flight guards
Workout History, PRs, and Exercise History render from settled cache state
Nutrition, Equipment, Exercise Directory, Body Metrics, Progress Intelligence, and System Health protected from duplicate in-flight loads
